title: Add idempotent optimizer procedure creation
description: Implement story plx-9bb525. Persist deterministic launch identity before mutation, create or recover the exact optimizer Procedure and Task atomically enough to survive an uncertain response, preserve per-target failures, forward every explicit execution limit, and expose stable child references for later monitoring. No score version or champion mutation is added.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Reworking the rejected caller-supplied deterministic-ID approach into the approved generated-ID at-most-once TaskDispatcher state machine. Outside-in coverage will require durable planned/create-attempted/provisioned/held/release-attempted/observed phases, paginated ambiguous-outcome adoption, HELD before sole release, stage reconciliation, and fail-closed unknown outcomes. No schema or production changes.
